items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: when we set this up we thought like you you'll create a deal rep assignment every time gets assigned to the deal / Kobi Kunasekaran: but what we talked about on last week was this will be one record per do rep combination / Kobi Kunasekaran: and then we would have a child object underneath this to track every every time you were assigned to that deal. Uh, sorry, every time the status for this deal assignment goes from like active to pause to whatever it is.
items.supersedes_hint: Replaces earlier model of multiple DRAs per rep per reassignment with one DRA per deal-rep plus a status-history child object (agreed the prior week).

items.topic: Referral currency independent of signup currency
items.statement: A US signup can have a Canadian referral payout and vice versa. Referral fields will be standard number fields with Referral Currency deciding USD or CAD; the signup base currency governs signup amounts.
items.quote: Lina Ceniccola: A US sign up could have a Canadian referral. / Kobi Kunasekaran: we'll we'll set set up all the referral related fields as just regular like standard number field and then we we will use like the referral currency to determine if it's if it should be USD or Canadian. / Kobi Kunasekaran: While this base currency field on the signup will govern the actual signup information.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Kobi Kunasekaran confirmed the project build is complete and that test data demos were successful.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: So from our end um not too many updates since our on-site um the PC is already built. Um we tested uh some data and we ran you through all the demos. So I marked all of those things as complete.
gemini_disagreements.why: Transcript says the POC ('PC') is built; the build phase is still in progress (build-phase stories just started, about two weeks to UAT). Gemini says the project build is complete.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Deal ID data exclusion The PlayCan API integration will not include a Deal ID, and will instead map records to deals using existing operator, partner, and market data fields.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: and if that's the case we could generate the deal ID on Salesforce and if you have a like you just need a field in play cam to hold that ID and we can actually do the mapping that way / Emily Vandenberg: Okay, I'll have we'll have to take that away, but let us get Yeah,
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary lists this as Aligned. In the transcript Kobi offered a Salesforce-generated Deal ID stored in PlayCan, and Emily took it away to decide. Mapping by operator/partner/market is the fallback, not a confirmed decision.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Manual proof link storage fields Salesforce will incorporate three URL fields to allow manual pasting of proof links, serving as a bridge until an automated storage solution is finalized. / [Kobi Kunasekaran] Add URL Fields: Add three URL fields to the signup records in Salesforce
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Emily Vandenberg: then you'll have time to kind of implement the URL field if needed, right? / Kobi Kunasekaran: we'll leave it as these three check boxes for now and then next week we'll come back
gemini_disagreements.why: Firmer than transcript. Lina supported the bridge 'if it's not a huge lift', Emily framed it as 'if needed' after a decision by next Tuesday, and Kobi closed with leaving the three checkboxes for now. Details also says Kobi will create checkboxes, but the checkboxes already exist.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Signup status process change The signup workflow will replace existing statuses with a "Flagged for Review" status, which locks the record and requires operational team intervention to unlock.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Lina Ceniccola: I think it would be again this isn't fully confirmed but I would / Kobi Kunasekaran: and then we could lock that record uh for the reps so that only ops go uh can go through
gemini_disagreements.why: Only two statuses (Won't Do, Flag) are replaced, not all existing statuses. The lock and Ops-only unflag were stated as 'not fully confirmed' / 'could', with Kobi to scope and show next call.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Operations teams will maintain exclusive control over fraud flagging and status updates to prevent unauthorized modifications.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Lina Ceniccola: I think it would be again this isn't fully confirmed but I would / Lina Ceniccola: like for it to if it goes to flagged operations has to be the one to like unfl flag it.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary states it as settled. Lina explicitly hedged it as not fully confirmed. It covers unflagging, not all fraud flagging and status updates (reps can still flag and complete).
